note: Realistic filled-in states in the Zarit Burden Interview (ZBI-22) scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.flaggedIssues via flagsHint "detectFlaggedIssues" with flagsArgs ["state","result"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectFlaggedIssues(state, grade); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.

flaggedIssues.description: ZBI-22 total 77 of 88 is in the severe-burden band (>= 61)
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Arrange urgent carer support and respite; screen and refer for carer mental-health support; consider the risk to the caring arrangement.

flaggedIssues.description: The carer rates their overall burden as "Nearly always" (item 22 = 4) — screen for carer depression and anxiety
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Screen the carer for depression and anxiety (for example PHQ-9 / GAD-7) and refer for carer mental-health support per the local pathway.

flaggedIssues.description: The carer rates their overall (global) burden as "Nearly always" (item 22 = 4 of 4)
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Explore the drivers of the high global burden and offer carer information, support, and signposting to respite and peer support.
